sequences.name: Seer
sequences.description: Grants basic divination abilities and an intuitive sense for danger. Can perform simple fortune-telling and gain vague glimpses of the future.

sequences.name: Clown
sequences.description: Enhances agility, balance, and reflexes to superhuman levels. Can juggle, tightrope walk, and perform impossible feats of coordination.

sequences.name: Magician
sequences.description: Masters illusion and misdirection. Can create convincing visual and auditory illusions, perform sleight of hand at supernatural speed, and bend perception.

sequences.name: Faceless
sequences.description: Can perfectly disguise as any person — copying voice, appearance, mannerisms, and even Beyonder signatures. The ultimate infiltrator.

sequences.name: Marionettist
sequences.description: Can create and control spirit thread marionettes from corpses or living targets. Controls up to three marionettes simultaneously with independent actions.

sequences.name: Bizarre Sorcerer
sequences.description: Commands strange and terrifying powers that defy logic. Can manipulate probability, create anomalous zones, and warp local reality through bizarre phenomena.

sequences.name: Scholar of Yore
sequences.description: Accesses the Historical Void — a record of everything that has ever existed. Can summon echoes of historical figures, borrow their abilities, and read the past.

sequences.name: Miracle Invoker
sequences.description: Can invoke miracles — rewriting small aspects of reality. Commands immense divine authority and can make the impossible possible within limits.

sequences.name: Attendant of Mysteries
sequences.description: Serves as a bridge to the divine. Holds tremendous authority over mystery and concealment, capable of hiding entire events from history.

sequences.name: The Fool
sequences.description: True God level. Complete authority over fate, mystery, history, and destiny. Can manipulate the very concept of 'luck' and control the Sefirah Castle.

sequences.name: Spectator
sequences.description: Can observe and read the emotional states of others. Gains heightened perception of body language and micro-expressions.

sequences.name: Reader
sequences.description: Absorbs knowledge from books at supernatural speed. Can memorize and perfectly recall vast amounts of written information.

sequences.name: Psychologist
sequences.description: Masters psychological analysis and suggestion. Can identify mental weaknesses and plant subtle behavioral suggestions in others.

sequences.name: Hypnotist
sequences.description: Can induce full hypnosis in willing or weakened targets. Capable of implanting deep-seated commands and erasing or altering memories.

sequences.name: Dream Weaver
sequences.description: Enters and manipulates the dreams of others. Can extract information from dreams and create elaborate dreamscapes.

sequences.name: Manipulator
sequences.description: Directly manipulates the thoughts and emotions of targets. Can control groups of people simultaneously through mass psychological influence.

sequences.name: Scholar of Yore
sequences.description: A convergence point where the Audience pathway meets the Seer. Gains access to historical knowledge through the psychological imprint left on objects and places.

sequences.name: Miracle Invoker
sequences.description: Invokes miracles through the collective unconscious and mass belief. Can manifest phenomena that masses collectively desire or fear.

sequences.name: Attendant of Mysteries
sequences.description: Wields immense psychological authority over reality itself. The boundary between mind and matter dissolves at this level.

sequences.name: The Fool
sequences.description: True God level. Complete dominion over the minds and perceptions of all beings. Reality itself becomes a stage.

sequences.name: Sailor
sequences.description: Gains enhanced physical strength, stamina, and an innate sense for navigation and weather. Can swim at superhuman speeds.

sequences.name: Folk of Rage
sequences.description: Can enter a controlled berserker rage, multiplying physical abilities. Gains resistance to pain and an intimidating aura.

sequences.name: Siren
sequences.description: Commands a captivating voice that can charm, confuse, or weaken listeners. Can communicate with aquatic creatures.

sequences.name: Wind-blessed
sequences.description: Controls wind and weather in their vicinity. Can summon gusts, fog, and rain, and can walk on air currents.

sequences.name: Cyclone
sequences.description: Generates powerful cyclones and storms. Can ride wind currents at incredible speed and devastate areas with localized hurricanes.

sequences.name: Sea King
sequences.description: Commands dominion over the ocean. Controls water itself, summons tidal waves, and rules over sea creatures. A demigod of the depths.

sequences.name: Calamity of Courage
sequences.description: Embodies the terror and awe of the sea at its most destructive. Commands earthquakes, tsunamis, and volcanic eruptions.

sequences.name: Typhoon
sequences.description: Becomes one with the storm. A walking natural disaster that can annihilate fleets and reshape coastlines.

sequences.name: Thunder God
sequences.description: Commands the fury of the heavens — lightning, thunder, and devastating storms of divine magnitude.

sequences.name: Tyrant
sequences.description: True God level. Absolute dominion over all storms, oceans, and natural forces. The world's weather bends to their will.

sequences.name: Bard
sequences.description: Uses music and poetry to inspire allies and demoralize enemies. Can detect lies through rhythmic sensitivity.

sequences.name: Dancer
sequences.description: Channels Beyonder power through dance and movement. Gains supernatural grace and evasion abilities.

sequences.name: Minstrel
sequences.description: Songs carry literal power — healing, strengthening, or weakening effects spread through melody.

sequences.name: Solar High Priest
sequences.description: Channels the power of light and the sun. Can purify corruption, create protective barriers, and emit blinding radiance.

sequences.name: Notary
sequences.description: Can formalize contracts and oaths with supernatural weight. Breaking a Notary's contract carries dire consequences.

sequences.name: Sunbro / Demigod
sequences.description: Embodies the purifying light of the sun. Radiates an aura of protection, heals allies, and burns corruption and evil.

sequences.name: Splendor
sequences.description: Radiates divine splendor that can blind enemies, purify entire areas, and inspire allies to heroic feats.

sequences.name: Lightbringer
sequences.description: Brings literal and metaphorical light to the world. Can banish darkness, corruption, and despair on a massive scale.

sequences.name: White Angel
sequences.description: An angelic being of pure radiance. Commands the full power of the sun and healing, nearly divine in scope.

sequences.name: Sun
sequences.description: True God level. Absolute authority over light, purification, and revelation. Darkness cannot exist in their presence.

sequences.name: Vampire
sequences.description: Gains enhanced senses, strength, and regeneration. Requires blood to sustain abilities. Can see perfectly in darkness.

sequences.name: Barbarian
sequences.description: Physical abilities are greatly amplified. Becomes nearly unstoppable in close combat with brutal strength.

sequences.name: Blood Shaman
sequences.description: Manipulates blood — their own and others'. Can coagulate wounds, weaponize blood, and sense the vitality of creatures.

sequences.name: Warlock
sequences.description: Commands dark magic and curses. Can place blood hexes, create vampiric servants, and draw power from the Abyss.

sequences.name: Hexer
sequences.description: Masters of curses and hexes that grow stronger over time. Can create lasting magical effects that slowly consume the target.

sequences.name: Vampire Duke / Demigod
sequences.description: A lord of the night with immense vampiric power. Commands shadows, controls lesser vampires, and rules the darkness.

sequences.name: Bat Wings of the Abyss
sequences.description: Gains mastery over the Abyss itself. Can open passages to the Abyss and command its denizens.

sequences.name: Moonblood
sequences.description: The blood itself becomes a divine substance. Immune to most corruption, and their blood can empower or destroy others.

sequences.name: Lord of the Night
sequences.description: Rules over all nocturnal creatures and shadows. The night itself is their domain and weapon.

sequences.name: Moon
sequences.description: True God level. Absolute authority over the night, blood, and the Abyss. The moon itself answers their call.

sequences.name: Apprentice
sequences.description: Learns quickly and can absorb skills from observation. Gains a supernatural ability to understand mechanisms and structures.

sequences.name: Trickster
sequences.description: Masters sleight of hand, escape artistry, and misdirection. Can slip free from any mundane restraint.

sequences.name: Astronomer
sequences.description: Reads the stars for navigation and prophecy. Understands spatial relationships at an intuitive level.

sequences.name: Conjurer
sequences.description: Can conjure small objects from distant locations. Begins to understand spatial manipulation.

sequences.name: Traveler
sequences.description: Can teleport short distances. Creates spatial shortcuts and warps local space for rapid movement.

sequences.name: Door / Demigod
sequences.description: Opens dimensional doors to anywhere. Can create stable portals across vast distances and pocket dimensions.

sequences.name: Planetary Wanderer
sequences.description: Traverses not just space but dimensions. Can visit mirrors, shadows, and other dimensional layers.

sequences.name: Key of Stars
sequences.description: The living key to any lock, barrier, or seal. No door in existence can remain closed to them.

sequences.name: Door to Everything
sequences.description: Can open passages between any two points in existence, including conceptual and abstract spaces.

sequences.name: Door
sequences.description: True God level. The concept of 'passage' and 'entry' itself. Nothing is beyond their reach.

sequences.name: Nighthawk
sequences.description: Gains enhanced night vision and the ability to sense danger in darkness. Can move silently through shadows.

sequences.name: Midnight Butcher
sequences.description: Excels at combat in darkness. Can temporarily blind opponents and strikes with lethal precision in low light.

sequences.name: Shadow Watcher
sequences.description: Can blend into shadows and observe without detection. Gains the ability to move between connected shadows.

sequences.name: Nightwatcher
sequences.description: Commands shadows as weapons and shields. Can create zones of supernatural darkness that consume light.

sequences.name: Watcher
sequences.description: Sees through all deception and concealment. Can observe events from great distances through shadow networks.

sequences.name: Fear of Darkness / Demigod
sequences.description: Becomes the embodiment of the terrors lurking in darkness. Can induce primal fear and command shadows as living entities.

sequences.name: Eternal Silence
sequences.description: Can extinguish all sound, light, and sensation in an area — creating a void of perfect darkness and silence.

sequences.name: Nightbringer
sequences.description: Brings eternal night to any location. Can plunge entire regions into perpetual, unnatural darkness.

sequences.name: Void Sovereign
sequences.description: Rules the space between spaces. Commands the primordial darkness that existed before light.

sequences.name: Darkness
sequences.description: True God level. The concept of darkness itself. Where they walk, light ceases to exist.

sequences.name: Arbiter
sequences.description: Gains an innate sense of truth and falsehood. Can detect lies and enforce basic rules of conduct.

sequences.name: Sheriff
sequences.description: Enhanced authority presence that demands compliance. Can issue commands that weaker minds feel compelled to follow.

sequences.name: Judge
sequences.description: Can formally judge targets, declaring guilt or innocence with supernatural weight. Judged targets suffer debilitation.

sequences.name: Magistrate
sequences.description: Issues binding rulings that affect reality within their jurisdiction. Creates zones where their laws are physically enforced.

sequences.name: Mind Calmer
sequences.description: Can calm any mind, suppress emotions, and impose order on chaotic situations. Nullifies psychological effects in their presence.

sequences.name: Imperator / Demigod
sequences.description: Commands divine authority that bends the will of others. Can issue decrees that reshape local reality to enforce order.

sequences.name: Chaos Hunter
sequences.description: Hunts down and purges chaos and disorder wherever it exists. Their mere presence suppresses anomalous phenomena.

sequences.name: Order
sequences.description: Becomes the living embodiment of cosmic order. Can impose structure on any chaotic system — physical, mental, or metaphysical.

sequences.name: Judge of All
sequences.description: Their judgment holds weight over all existence. Can pass sentence on any being, concept, or phenomenon.

sequences.name: Arbiter
sequences.description: True God level. The concept of judgment and cosmic law itself. Their word is absolute.

sequences.name: Mystery Pryer
sequences.description: Gains a sixth sense for the mystical and hidden. Can detect supernatural presences and hidden truths.

sequences.name: Instigator
sequences.description: Can subtly provoke emotions and reactions in others. Plants seeds of discord, inspiration, or courage through words.

sequences.name: Conspirator
sequences.description: Masters manipulation and intrigue. Can orchestrate complex schemes and predict social dynamics with supernatural accuracy.

sequences.name: Provocateur
sequences.description: Can directly inflame emotions and provoke actions. Their words carry supernatural weight, compelling action from listeners.

sequences.name: Prophet
sequences.description: Receives genuine prophetic visions. Can see glimpses of possible futures and write predictions that may become reality.

sequences.name: Counselor / Demigod
sequences.description: Advises with supernatural wisdom. Their counsel reshapes the decisions of nations. Can foresee and manipulate grand events.

sequences.name: Mysticologist
sequences.description: Understands the deepest mysteries of the world. Can perceive hidden connections between seemingly unrelated events.

sequences.name: Prophecy
sequences.description: Their words become self-fulfilling prophecies. What they speak into existence has a supernatural tendency to come true.

sequences.name: Oracle
sequences.description: Speaks with divine authority. Their prophetic words reshape fate itself on a grand scale.

sequences.name: Mystery
sequences.description: True God level. The concept of mystery and prophecy itself. All secrets are revealed to them, and their word shapes destiny.
